backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the CA Final Study Tracker backend, defining data types (UserProfile, Subject, Chapter, StudySession, Test, etc.) and state maps, with access-controlled CRUD operations for profiles, subjects, chapters, study sessions, tests, revision topics, rewards, and question papers.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report declaring that the application was reverted to Version 18 state, listing the affected frontend files and component dependencies with high confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted catalog of frontend file summaries describing the purpose and key details of each component, hook, page, and config file in the frontend source tree.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for the light and dark color themes used throughout the application.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React app, setting the page title to 'CA Final Study Tracker' and mounting the app at the `#root` div.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that sets up TanStack Router with all application routes (Dashboard, StudySessions, RevisionSchedule, Tests, SubjectDetail, ArchivedChapters, Rewards, QuestionPapers, ErrorLog), wrapped in ThemeProvider and QueryClientProvider.
frontend/src/components/AddChapterDialog: Dialog component for adding a new chapter to a subject, with fields for chapter name and total topics; submits to the backend actor and invalidates the chapters query cache on success.
frontend/src/components/AddRevisionDialo: Dialog wrapper component that renders RevisionForm inside a modal for adding a new revision topic, closing the dialog on successful submission.
frontend/src/components/AddSubjectDialog: A dialog component that wraps SubjectForm in a modal for adding a new subject, closing on successful submission.
frontend/src/components/AddTestDialog.ts: A dialog component that wraps TestForm in a modal for adding a new test, closing on successful submission.
frontend/src/components/AISuggester.tsx: Card component that displays personalized study suggestions including overdue revisions, focus areas, and low-score subjects derived from revision, subject, and completed-test hooks.
frontend/src/components/ChapterCard.tsx: A card component for displaying and managing a chapter, supporting inline name editing, completion toggling, and PDF upload/view functionality.
frontend/src/components/EditSubjectDialo: A stub passthrough component for editing subjects that renders its children directly, as subject editing is handled at the chapter level.
frontend/src/components/ExamCountdown.ts: A countdown timer card that displays days, hours, minutes, and seconds remaining until a hardcoded CA Final exam date of May 1, 2028.
frontend/src/components/InnerCAVoice.tsx: A motivational quote card that displays a random CA-themed quote with a refresh button to cycle through quotes.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: The main app layout component handling authentication state, navigation sidebar, and rendering a profile setup modal for new users.
frontend/src/components/PdfUploader.tsx: A file input component that validates and uploads a PDF (max 10MB) for a given chapter to the backend actor with simulated progress display.
frontend/src/components/PdfViewer.tsx: A dialog component that fetches and renders a chapter's PDF notes in an iframe, with a download option.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: A non-dismissible modal that prompts new authenticated users to enter their name and save their profile via the backend actor.
frontend/src/components/QuestionPaperLis: Displays a list of uploaded question papers fetched via `useQuestionPapers`, showing name and upload date, with a button to open each paper in a `QuestionPaperViewer` dialog.
frontend/src/components/QuestionPaperUpl: Form component for uploading a PDF question paper (max 10MB) with a name label, validating file type/size and submitting via `useUploadQuestionPaper` mutation.
frontend/src/components/QuestionPaperVie: Dialog component that fetches and renders a question paper PDF as a blob URL inside an iframe, with a download button, using `useQuestionPaperPdf`.
frontend/src/components/RevisionForm.tsx: Form for scheduling a revision topic by selecting a subject, entering a topic name, and picking a date, then submitting via the actor's `addRevisionTopic` method.
frontend/src/components/RevisionSchedule: Displays revision topics grouped into overdue, upcoming, and completed sections, with a button to mark each incomplete topic as done via `markRevisionComplete`.
frontend/src/components/RewardCard.tsx: Card component that renders a single reward's name, description, unlock condition, progress bar, bonus XP, and locked/unlocked status.
frontend/src/components/SessionSummaries: Displays a scrollable list of session summaries fetched via `useSessionSummaries`, with a copy-to-clipboard button for each entry.
Displays a study streak card with a dynamic flame icon and motivational message that scales visually based on the user's current streak count fetched via useUserProgress.
frontend/src/components/StudySessionForm: A form component for logging study sessions with fields for date, subject, hours, topics, and error log, submitting data to the backend actor via a mutation and invalidating related queries on success.
frontend/src/components/StudySessionHist: Renders a scrollable list of past study sessions sorted by date, showing subject, hours, topics covered, and optional error logs with loading skeletons.
frontend/src/components/SubjectCard.tsx: Displays a single subject as a card with its name, chapter count, a delete button, and a navigation link to the subject's detail page.
frontend/src/components/SubjectForm.tsx: A form for adding a new subject with name and chapter count fields, requiring the user to be authenticated via Internet Identity before submitting to the backend actor.
frontend/src/components/SubjectProgressO: Shows a grid of all subjects with their emoji, name, and chapter count fetched via useSubjects, with loading and empty-state handling.
frontend/src/components/TestAnalyticsCha: Renders test performance analytics using Recharts, offering a score timeline line chart and a subject average bar chart built from completed test data.
frontend/src/components/TestCard.tsx: Renders a single test card showing name, subject, and completion status, with an inline score input form that submits scores via mutation and awards XP on success.
frontend/src/components/TestForm.tsx: Form component for creating a new test with fields for name, subject, date, total marks, and chapters, submitting the data via a mutation to the backend actor.
frontend/src/components/TestHistory.tsx: Displays pending and completed tests in tabs using TestCard components, and shows a subject-wise average score progress view computed from completed test data.
frontend/src/components/TodayGoalCard.ts: Card component for setting and tracking a daily study hour goal, with controls to set the goal and increment logged hours via backend mutations.
frontend/src/components/XPLevelCard.tsx: Displays the user's current XP, level, level name, and progress toward the next level using a progress bar, with level thresholds and names defined statically.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using React Query, reinitializing and invalidating dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useArchivedChapters.t: React Query hook that fetches all chapters from the actor and filters them to return only completed (archived) ones.
frontend/src/hooks/useChapters.ts: React Query hook that fetches all chapters from the actor, with optional filtering by subject name and a helper to invalidate the chapters cache.
frontend/src/hooks/useCompletedTests.ts: React Query hook that fetches and returns the list of completed tests from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useErrorLogs.ts: React Query hook that fetches study sessions containing errors via the `getSessionsWithErrors` actor method.
frontend/src/hooks/useEvaluateRewards.ts: Mutation hook that fetches current rewards from the actor and invalidates the rewards query cache on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetCallerUserProfi: React Query hook that retrieves the authenticated caller's user profile from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and provider, managing login, logout, and identity state via DFINITY's AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/usePdfBlobs.ts: React Query hook that fetches the notes PDF blob for a specific chapter by its ID.
frontend/src/hooks/usePendingTests.ts: React Query hook that retrieves all non-completed tests from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder/barrel file noting that queries are organized into dedicated hooks; exports nothing.
frontend/src/hooks/useQuestionPaperPdf.t: React Query hook that fetches the PDF blob for a specific question paper by name.
frontend/src/hooks/useQuestionPapers.ts: React Query hook that retrieves metadata (name and upload date) for all question papers from the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useRevisionSchedule.t: React Query hook that fetches all revision topics from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useRevisionSuggestion: React Query hook that derives up to 5 overdue revision topic suggestions from the revision schedule data.
frontend/src/hooks/useRewards.ts: React Query hook that fetches the list of rewards from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useSessionSummaries.t: React Query hook that maps study sessions with non-empty topics into summary entries of subject and topics covered.
frontend/src/hooks/useStudySessions.ts: React Query hook that fetches all study sessions from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useSubjects.ts: React Query hook that fetches the list of subjects from the actor, requiring both actor and Internet Identity to be available.
React Query hook that returns up to 3 subject name suggestions derived from the existing subjects list.
frontend/src/hooks/useTests.ts: React Query hook that fetches and combines both completed and pending tests into a single array.
frontend/src/hooks/useTodayGoal.ts: React Query hook that retrieves today's study goal from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useUploadQuestionPape: Mutation hook that uploads a question paper PDF to the backend actor and invalidates the question papers cache on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserProgress.ts: React Query hook that fetches user XP/level/streak progress, plus a helper hook to invalidate the progress cache.
frontend/src/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS stylesheet defining a Spider-Man red-and-blue themed design system with light/dark mode CSS custom properties and a subtle web-pattern overlay utility.
frontend/src/lib/actorTypes.ts: TypeScript type definitions for all domain entities (Subject, Chapter, Test, etc.) and the ExtendedActor interface that extends the backend canister interface with all callable methods.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
Displays a list of all completed/archived chapters across subjects, fetched via useArchivedChapters hook, with loading skeletons and an empty state.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Main dashboard page showing stats (subjects, chapters, XP, streak), a subject list with add functionality, and widgets like AI suggester, exam countdown, and motivational voice.
frontend/src/pages/ErrorLogPage.tsx: Shows a sorted list of study sessions that contain error logs, displaying subject, date, hours studied, topics covered, and the error note per session.
frontend/src/pages/QuestionPapersPage.ts: Page for uploading and listing CA exam question papers, composing the QuestionPaperUploader and QuestionPaperList components in a two-column grid.
Revision schedule page that renders the RevisionSchedule component and an AddRevisionDialog button, disabling the add action if no subjects exist.
frontend/src/pages/RewardVaultPage.tsx: Displays unlockable rewards in a grid and provides a 'Check Rewards' button that triggers reward evaluation, showing toast notifications for newly unlocked rewards.
frontend/src/pages/StudySessionsPage.tsx: Study sessions page combining subject progress overview, a session log form, session summaries, revision schedule, and session history in a two-column layout.
frontend/src/pages/SubjectDetailPage.tsx: Detail page for a single subject showing its chapters with completion progress bar, and an AddChapterDialog for adding new chapters.
frontend/src/pages/TestsPage.tsx: Tests page that displays a test analytics chart and test history, with an AddTestDialog button that is disabled until at least one subject exists.
frontend/src/utils/caQuotes.ts: Exports an array of 25 motivational CA exam quotes and utility functions to retrieve a random quote or a random quote excluding the current one.
frontend/src/utils/topicEmojis.ts: Provides a getTopicEmoji function that deterministically maps a topic name string to one of 24 emojis using a character-code hash.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom theme tokens (colors via OKLCH variables, fonts, border radii, shadows, animations) and enabling typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project state metadata file tracking version 3 of a fix request to revert the entire application to Version 18, undoing changes from Versions 19–21.
